rationale: Starter layer configuration (Story 3.2): Relax, from starter-recipes.md and design log 2026-10-27 (m). Theta reference: a 450 Hz carrier amplitude-modulated by the sine envelope at 6 Hz, 75 percent AM depth. Gamma PAC layer: a 250 Hz sine carrier amplitude-modulated at 40 Hz, its AM depth swelling to 25 percent at the 0 degree coupling phase (smooth swell). No binaural layer. 30 min, no loop. No level ramps or fades (Epic 4). Not the Epic 6 starter recipe.
